answer.camera_language: Living, gently floating coverage grounds the morning routine; a measured push gives Kasun's ambition intimacy, then a calm rise returns him to the working street.

clips.motivation: Give the working street an observational pulse without making the vehicle a grand reveal.
clips.opens_on: Green vehicle at left, road receding diagonally across the frame
clips.lands_on: Vehicle still at left, with the working road dominant
clips.composition_note: Preserve the vehicle in the left quarter throughout the visible sideways float.
clips.why: A short lateral float makes the street feel observed rather than presented.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level wide view, the camera floats slowly right as traffic passes, easing to rest with the vehicle still at frame-left.

clips.direction: gentle lateral and vertical sway around the counter framing
clips.motivation: Make the preparation feel familiar and human while preserving the cramped working space.
clips.opens_on: Kasun left of centre above the counter and preparation implements
clips.lands_on: Kasun and the same waist-level working surface
clips.composition_note: Keep Kasun left of centre and the flask and working surface within the lower frame.
clips.why: Visible, relaxed handheld breathing gives his economical routine warmth without editorial emphasis.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium shot with gentle handheld floating and swaying as he prepares the counter, easing as his hands come to rest.

clips.direction: gentle sway around the shared counter
clips.trigger: the worker closes the final step to the counter
clips.motivation: Stay companionably present for an ordinary exchange rather than dramatizing the transaction.
clips.opens_on: Kasun left, worker right, cup between them
clips.lands_on: Both men across the counter with the worker holding the cup
clips.composition_note: Balance the faces on either side and preserve space below them for the cup exchange.
clips.why: A gently swaying shared frame lets the friendliness emerge from the service itself.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level two-shot, the frame gently floats and sways as the customer approaches and collects his tea, easing once the exchange is complete.

clips.trigger: the worker grips and lifts the cup
clips.motivation: Give the small act of service a tactile punctuation by accompanying the cup's lift.
clips.opens_on: Cup centred on the counter between cream sleeve and flask
clips.lands_on: Cup held just above the counter in the worker's right hand
clips.composition_note: Use a short upward tilt, retaining the cup as the centre of attention without revealing faces.
clips.why: Following the cup gives the insert life without exaggerating a routine purchase.
clips.camera_sentence: Counter-height insert, the camera slowly tilts upward with the lifted cup, then settles.

clips.direction: left toward Kasun and the worn service area
clips.trigger: the worker clears frame-right and Kasun turns inward
clips.motivation: Transfer attention from the completed sale to the small space Kasun must work within.
clips.opens_on: Kasun left inside the service opening, departing worker at the right edge
clips.lands_on: Kasun within the narrow counter and worn vehicle fittings
clips.composition_note: Make only a short pan into the existing service opening, retaining the cramped fittings around Kasun.
clips.why: We stay with Kasun rather than chase the customer, letting his working limits become the subject.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium-wide shot, the camera slowly pans left as he turns inward, settling on the cramped service area.

clips.direction: toward the hand and old flask
clips.trigger: Kasun's wrist relaxes beside the counter
clips.motivation: Give the old equipment and narrow working surface quiet weight without suggesting defeat.
clips.opens_on: Left hand and flask beside a strip of counter, soft fitting at the edge
clips.lands_on: Slightly closer detail of the same hand, flask and narrow counter
clips.composition_note: Keep the soft vehicle edge at the margin throughout the short forward travel.
clips.why: A patient creep makes the modest tools matter without turning them into symbols of misery.
clips.camera_sentence: Slightly high insert, the camera creeps very slowly toward the hand and flask as his wrist relaxes, easing to rest.

clips.trigger: L6 begins after Kasun turns toward the road
clips.motivation: Let the scene's strongest approach belong to his quiet statement of ambition.
clips.opens_on: Kasun's head and upper chest at left with roadward looking room
clips.lands_on: Closer three-quarter view of Kasun's face with looking room retained
clips.composition_note: Maintain his left-side placement and rightward eyeline as the frame tightens from MCU to CU.
clips.why: One measured push lets us share his conviction without making the declaration grand.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium close-up, the camera slowly pushes into a close-up as he speaks his ambition, then comes to rest.

clips.trigger: Kasun takes a quiet breath after L6
clips.motivation: Carry the intimacy of his declaration into the silent resolve that follows.
clips.opens_on: Kasun's close profile at left with soft road space to the right
clips.lands_on: A slightly tighter close profile retaining roadward looking room
clips.composition_note: Keep the travel shorter than the declaration's push and retain the profile's rightward space.
clips.why: A shorter, gentler continuation lets resolve linger without creating a second emotional climax.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level close profile, the camera creeps very slowly closer as he takes a quiet breath, then settles.

clips.direction: gentle lateral and vertical sway around the counter framing
clips.trigger: Kasun smiles and turns back to work
clips.motivation: Reconnect the private ambition to the same practical rhythm established during preparation.
clips.opens_on: Kasun left of centre looking right, flask and counter at waist level
clips.lands_on: Kasun turned inward over the same working surface
clips.composition_note: Repeat setup B's left-weighted framing and relaxed handheld sway.
clips.why: Returning to the same living medium frame makes the dream part of his routine rather than an escape from it.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium shot with gentle handheld floating and swaying as he smiles and returns to work, easing as he settles.

clips.direction: gently upward above the roadside view
clips.trigger: Kasun resumes tending the short eats
clips.motivation: Return his private hope to the scale of an ordinary working morning.
clips.opens_on: Eye-level wide view with vehicle and Kasun left, open road right
clips.lands_on: Slightly elevated wide view of the vehicle and working street
clips.composition_note: Begin at eye level and rise a modest distance, preserving the vehicle on the left third and road on the right.
clips.why: A restrained rise closes on continued effort and the street, not a heroic portrait.
clips.camera_sentence: Wide view beginning at eye level, the camera slowly rises to a slightly high angle as he works, then gently comes to rest.

notes: 1I-1: lens 85mm close focus -> 85mm (the frame brief must follow)
1G-1: lens 65mm close focus -> 65mm (the frame brief must follow)
